mapper.select: SELECT driver_name AS driverName, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(single_mileage), 0),2) AS totalMileage FROM dwd_vehicle_car_task_record WHERE driver_name IS NOT NULL AND single_mileage IS NOT NULL AND depart_time >= #{minDay} AND depart_time <= #{maxDay} GROUP BY driverName ORDER BY totalMileage DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT car_plate) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT car_plate) END, 2 ) AS avgDepartCount, ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT driver_name) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(single_mileage), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT driver_name) END, 2 ) AS perCapitaMileageKm FROM dwd_vehicle_car_task_record WHERE driver_name IS NOT NULL AND car_plate IS NOT NULL AND single_mileage IS NOT NULL AND depart_time >= #{minDay} AND depart_time <= #{maxDay}

SELECT TO_CHAR(depart_time, #{timeType}) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "MATRIX"."dwd_vehicle_car_task_record" WHERE depart_time >= #{minDay} AND depart_time <= #{maxDay} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(depart_time, #{timeType})

SELECT TO_CHAR(depart_time, #{timeType}) AS date, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(single_mileage), 0),2) AS totalMileage FROM "MATRIX"."dwd_vehicle_car_task_record" WHERE single_mileage IS NOT NULL AND depart_time >= #{minDay} AND depart_time <= #{maxDay} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(depart_time, #{timeType})
